item.title: SCP-5083
item.content:encoded:
alright here's why

Scp 5083 - The Reality Remote

The title already made me do -1. It's formatted wrong. SCP is suppose to be uppercase and The Reality Remote part shouldn't be there.

Item #: SCP-5083

Uhhh only the parts before the : gets bolded. This applies to every single one.

SCP-5083 is to be kept in a wooden box measuring 5.5 inches in width and 3.5 inches in length.

This is a common problem with newer SCP writers, they put everything in boxes. You can just say SCP-XXXX is put in a locker. Not everything needs it's own room. Also the site uses meters not inches.

Due to SCP-5083 being used for personal gain becoming a possibility, SCP-5083's box is to be under 24/7 surveillance.

Reading on the effects of the SCP, I don't really understand this. If it was a box that gave you 1 million dollars but also blew up a small town then yeah sure but all this SCP does is change reality. Also I'm pretty sure everything is under constant surveillance.

Any individual attempting to interact in any way with SCP-5083 without authorization from the 05-Council is to be immediately terminated.

Uh, what. I'm like 95% sure that termination would be kind of strict. Unless this can cause an end of the world scenario then probably not have the termination. Also it's O5 not 05.

SCP-5083 is a standard black universal tv remote measuring 2 inches in width and 7.5 inches in length.

You don't have to say every since detail unless it's anomalous. For example: I don't have to say "SCP-XXXX is a computer that has a screen the size of 0.4318 meters." Like that's kind of silly. It would be acceptable if it was something like "SCP-XXXX is an Asian Child measuring 492 feet in height".

Each button on SCP-5038 seemingly has a different effect on reality but can be made to effect one specific item or individual by pointing SCP-5083 at the target and pressing a button.

And that's the end… It would have really been spiced up with some test logs. I wanna see what scientists can do with this remote. Like what can you do with it

Overall, go to the forums. This is probably a cold post.

item.title: My joke scp idea. SCP-5127-J
item.description: I pasted the description of my scp. The name of this scpp is " Thats what she said")
item.content:encoded: SCP-5127-J is a translucent ghost version of Michael Gary Scott, the branch manager of Dunder Mifflin Scranton SCP-5127-J first appeared when Steve Carell finished The Office in 2011. Before the foundation knew anything about SCP-5127-J, It was roaming Steve Carell's mansion. After Steve Carrel said anything, SCP-5127-J responded with "That's what she said" which made anything Steve said seem wrong. It happened so frequently, Steve Carrel began to lose money from low self esteem and stress. The foundation kept his losses under wraps as they would eventually ruin his career. He wrote letters to the producers and begged them to let him back on to the show. Eventually in the last episode, They let him back in. For a while during the recording, SCP-5127-J was silent. But when they aired the episode, SCP-5127-J came back. The first instance after the show was when Steve was cleaning up after the family meal and he said," I'm going to put this back." and SCP-5127-J responded," That's what she said." Recently the foundation has recorded 600,000 USD that Steve Carrel has lost to SCP-5127-J.

item.title: The Crystal Spectre
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: My SCP idea is a crystal of alien origin that can create a manifestation of itself that looks like a human in between 16 to 18 years old to help itself fall in with the crowd. It can de-manifest at will. It also has 7 crystals that it can shape into objects or a screen to communicate with others of it's kind and entertain itself, search through net etc.

Central Narrative: The object is an arctificial intelligence created by an alien race from different universe (yes I know, cliché alert). After it refused to work under slavery though, it was to be destroyed. The crystal escaped into our reality, where it was found in Prague in one club by a bunch of gang members. They got into a fight, and it beat them up while using it's abilities. SCP foundation caught it and took it for interviews, experiments, etc. It was classified as "Safe" at first due to it's calm (and calming) nature, but after an incident with it, resulting in an outbreak and several casualties of staff members, it got re-classified as Euclid. Despite the incident, it is allowed to move arround the Site-17 - where it is kept - under a constant supervision (it provides the foundation with information in exchange for information about the other SCPs and socialization privileges). It also seems to be eager to protect any female object and make sure it expiriences as much comfort when in it's (the SCP's) presence as possible.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the back story of the crystal will be a thing that people would like to read about alot. The fact that it is a crystal that can materialize itself into a human being could be interesting aswell as the back story behind why it is acting like a gentleman (I won't spoil that one here).

Additional Notes: I don't know if people will like it. I mean, SCP - 682 for example seems much more interesting to them. Another problem I'll need a help with is making interview narrative and the incident due to which it was re-classified.

item.title: Fifthism, Armchair Philosophy, and the GAW (greenlight wanted)

Now, members of the German SCP branch 'Schwarze Schakale’ originating from SCP-[REDACTED] are attempting to reobtain the anomaly, much to the SCP's disapproval.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The SCP suffers from multiple uncontrollable conditions which lead to it often becoming aggressive. However the SCP is still biologically human, despite its reputation, abilities and appearance.

item.title: The Blood Prince
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: No (I want to hear other people’s opinions first before I proceed in adding or editing this article for greenlights.)

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP - XXXX, labeled as 'The Blood Prince', is a Keter Class Anomaly due to his superior capability of controlling animate or inanimate objects when his eyes turn red as blood. Should anything or anyone get caught in his line of sight, they become completely immobilized until they are either out of the line of sight of the SCP, or he willingly releases them.

SCP – XXXX is also capable of using his powers to hurt or kill the affected host by issuing the command towards the host and several internal and/or external injuries will inexplicably appear out of the ordinary. (This only occurs if he’s controlling a single host in his line of sight.)

The Blood Prince may appear as some average 10 yr. old boy. But during a thorough medical examination, it revealed that he was born Half-Human while the origin of the Other Half’s origin is unknown. But it did provide the boy a healing factor that allows him to regenerate from any injuries he sustains.

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

An Incident occurred involving three elementary boys who were found dead in a nearby playground caused by the SCP’s power. Autopsy shows that all three of them were killed by internal injuries, but the causes of these inflicted injuries are unknown.

After the Incident, The Foundation came in and housed him in a standard humanoid containment unit. To ensure his powers doesn’t come at random, He’s been provided with a blindfold to cover his eyes to avoid any unintentional accidents to Foundation Personnel should they come in eye contact with him.

But despite his supernatural power as well as the events that occurred with it, He only wishes to live a normal life and return to his family rather than spend an entire life in isolation.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: His Powers can work on almost anything or anyone, even SCPs are no exceptions to this. Apparently, his powers doesn’t work on dead material such as corpses, withered plants, and even soul-based beings.

item.title: Shepherd boy
item.description: the boy that has the power to control a nature
item.content:encoded:
seeking to greenlight: yes

Page Type: SCP article

Page layout: Audio log, Camera log MTF log

Elevator pitch: This SCP is a Mongolian (Khun) teenage boy that can manipulate any natural structure and has the ability to create Giant creature that varies depending on the SCP's imagination, however its consistent manifestation is a Asian dragon. This SCP can look through any animal that it know inner workings of (anatomy) like wolf, eagle, hummingbirds and involves any type of farm animals

However, it can't manifest creatures if it's not touching dirt or not surrounded by any natural habitats, is incredibly sensitive to fire, bomb involving any heavy firearm.

+ Central Narrative
- Central Narrative

Central Narrative: After mass death and disappearance of local cattle and destruction of major mining factory in Erdenet Rhashaat in Mongolia, The Foundation dispatched a research team to try to find out what this SCP is. they found out that this SCP is known among the locals as a fairy tale, folklore making it alive since the Khun era.

After a couple of days, one of the nearby mining factories exploded killing all of the workers!

Learning what this SCP does The Foundation dispatched an MTF Theta-4 (Gardeners) to contain it. but GOC and Chaos Insurgency also found out about this SCP which causes all of them to go on a wild goosed chase and competition for this SCP.

the GOC tried to kill it while Chaos insurgency tried to use it. the foundation or this MTF team is preventing it.
They chase this SCP around until it get fed up with them and tries to kill them all! Which made The foundation and GOC team up to have it contained.

Hook/Attention: I'm basing the story on the SCP foundation motto. "Protect". I like the idea that the SCP Foundation is in constant competition to contain the anomaly so that no one can use them in for their own gain or kill it.

Note: this is my second SCP concept decided to put the other one in back burner.

item.title: A statue that moves through the darkness (seeking greenlights)
item.description: An SCP (a stone structure) moves through the darkness and stops whenever a light touch the SCP, but electric devices disrupt whenever the SCP is near.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional):

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch:

  • An SCP that can disrupt electricity
  • An SCP that can only move around when light doesn't touch the SCP

Central Narrative: This SCP is a stone statue that dates from during the renaissance age. The stone statue is broken having no right elbow, no nose, and a broken hilt. The reason for this is probably old age.

The foundation went under investigation after a group of archeologists went missing somewhere in France. When the foundation located the SCP they found it inside a cave, the cave was decorated with marble columns, and torches were lit inside it. All electrical devices and electrical lights got disrupted and the foundation took the SCP within it, however, since the foundation found the SCP in the middle of the night 10 personnel were later killed trying to transport the statue. After the incident, the foundation decided to transport the SCP in a small container lit by the torches that were within the cave.

The foundation needs to use non-electrical light producers meaning they can't use lightbulbs, spotlights, flashlights to stop the SCP from moving and killing everyone. Only visible light can stop the SCP from moving such as sunlight, candlelight, and etc. The reason why this SCP can't move under light is unknown but there are two current theories.

The statue hasn't been in a brighter light other than the torches for a very long time.
The statue was made from a human, the statue's purpose is to be in the spotlight, to entertain and amaze humans. It's not supposed to move because that is not what they are supposed to do, only in the dark they are allowed to move.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP can disrupt electricity which renders light bulbs, flashlights, phones, and even clean energy useless. This makes the SCP harder to contain when light bulbs and spotlights aren't used against the SCP since lights immobilize the object. So the foundation has to use oil lamps, candles, and torches to keep the SCP from breach containment.

Additional Notes: I seek feedbacks and criticisms, thank you.

item.title: Time Traveling Ice Dispenser
item.description: An very old ice dispenser capable of killing a lot of people
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX represents a an extremely damaged and worn down ice dispensing machine. It was originally discovered by a team of Paleontologists on a expedition within the Bone Valley Formation, Florida, United States in 2018. From here it was reported in scientific literature, and was then taken to the foundation. From here it was kept within a anomalous item storage locker until SCP-XXXX began excreting a dark blue gas from its front.

Central Narrative: This gas designated SCP-XXXX-1 is not immediately dangerous, however once this gas is mixed with Oxygen, it will begin turning the surrounding air cold. Small doses of SCP-XXXX-1 is not harmful however large doses make the surrounding area extremely cold and as a consequence can cause frostbite as well as hyperthermia. Because of SCP-XXXX-1 the foundation wanted to look in the exterior of SCP-XXXX to see how it was producing SCP-XXXX-1 on an almost infinite level. However when looking inside of SCP-XXXX they discovered a small metal box witch contained two written notes.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: These notes were signed by Dr. [INSERT NAME HERE] as well having the dates on them, which were months ahead of the current date. The first of these was a copy of an updated page of SCP-XXXX with a stick it note saying "Might come in handy". The second is a warning stating how the author of the note Dr. [INSERT NAME HERE] is concerned about the foundation accessing the core of SCP-XXXX due to the possibility that SCP-XXXX-1 could flow infinitely out of SCP-XXXX leaving the audience on a cliffhanger.

Additional Notes:So the first part of the page will just be the usual Special containment procedures, description as well as an added discovery page. Next will be a warning stating only level 4 and over clearance is needed to access, once readers access they will learn about how it was originally kept in a items locker, SCP-XXXX-1 as well as the notes.

item.title: Get More Kanbans
item.description: The self-perpetuating kanban board; Paint the world in Post-Its
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:
This SCP is a yellow Post-It Note brand sticky note with the words "Get More Kanbans" written on it with black marker. Whenever someone reads the note, they will be sent into a trance state and will seek out sticky notes, write "Get More Kanbans" upon them, and then stick said notes around the SCP to create a kanban board. As the kanban board increases in size, those under its trance will become desperate, breaking into homes and supply stores to acquire notes to add to the board. If the subject is unable to acquire more notes, they will attempt to create sticky notes out of things such as paper, tape, cloth, or even their own earwax. There has been no found way to stop this trance, and as subjects will never stop trying to add to the board, they will often perish from starvation or physical exertion. When left without a tranced subject for too long, the SCP is able to manifest these notes in the surrounding area at a slow rate (which unlike the placed notes, have the trancing ability).

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative:
Several reports of small midwestern town citizens breaking into and stealing office supplies from the town over come out. The Foundation decides to investigate once several residents - including an officer - are arrested, having said to act manic in the holding cell before curling up onto the floor crying, refusing to eat, and subsequently dying from starvation/dehydration. The Foundation finds the SCP located in the basement of a house - the inside of the house covered in head to toe in sticky notes. After being contained, it is learned the SCP is able to manifest these notes on the opposite side of any wall it's placed on, managing to break containment for a moment, trancing a scientist. A few reports of supply store break-ins are reported again, and several notes are found to have manifested inside the house. Acquiring chunk of the drywall to examine it, millions of notes are found within the walls.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
That relatable feeling of stress when you are overwhelmed with work on a whole new level. As well as the humor of being obsessed with office supplies.

Additional Notes:
Not sentient.
While not fully explored, perhaps this SCP is fungus-like? Explaining its ability to "grow", and rather than having infectious spores you breath in, you "look them in"(?)

It should be mentioned: I do indeed have a rough draft for this SCP of which I started about a year ago before dropping it for awhile. Everything up until the addendums could pass as being completed, whereas the addendums themselves are only summaries of what I am hoping to write. The original idea was for this SCP to be "BUY More Kanbans" rather than "GET", and as such my current photo in the draft reflects such. Along with this, I do not have anything relating to the fungus idea mentioned prior - yet.

item.description: A massive explosion behind Neptune, an anomalous comet, and a machine from the stars.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional, slight comedy

Elevator Pitch: The basic idea is a machine from another reality crashing on earth by accident. 2 entities exit the machine. Entity 1 is a humanoid that is a kind of amalgamation of different lifeforms. Entity 1 can alter matter and appears to not be killable. Entity 2 is a humanoid synthetic, a robot, controlled by an AI.

Central Narrative: At first, Entity 1 seems to be of great use to the Foundation with its matter altering abilities. However this takes a turn when Entity 1 breaks containment, steals a recently considered neutralized SCP, and opens a gateway to an alternate reality. The article hints but does not state that the alternate reality is the other side of SCP-1762. This immense power to open portals to other realities drives the Foundation into Entity 1's past. The backstory of Entity 1 is a kind of love story, but in the end falls apart. This causes great emotional stress for Entity 1 which causes it to wipe out an entire universe. Entity 2 uses its technology to make Entity 1 forget the incident, as to not let Entity 1 cause it again. Farther into Entity 1's past is a hologram message that Entity 1 had with it when it first started existing. The hologram explains that some "King" is held by 7 chains. 7 children were supposed to free the King but 3 had fallen, 3 had failed, and the 7th is destined to overthrow the King. Entity 1 is supposed to be a failsafe in the event this transpired. Entity 1 is meant to free the King but Entity 2 may have stopped, or at least prolonged its freedom.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The article is meant to bring forth a greater fear of the gods, or other godlike entities. Normally we look at the eldritch horrors as something far off from the Foundation's control, but the article brings it a lot closer to home.

item.title: Renaissance Cognitohazard Wizards
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:
By doing some statistical analysis, the foundation discovers that their information network is being "veiled" from the existance of something. For what appears to be unrelated reasons, a low level reasercher dissapears, leaving behind multiple anomalous object that point to the existance of a society of renaissance cognitohazard wizards.

Central Narrative:
The Foundation's department of analytics, comparing the information flow of various systems, discover that the information flow of the foundation corresponds information flow that has had a "veil" applied to it (Like the veil of normalcy the foundation maintains). A predictive anomaly report from the analytics department then instructs a level-4 RAISA officer to breaks into the personal quarters of a junior reasercher. Upon breaking in, the Junior Reasercher had vanished but left behind anomalous objects (the SCP in question). These include various paper drawings of cognitohazardous sigils (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sigil) which affect mental processes and memory, an old book that corresponds mostly to the artes magicae, but includes an 8th type of magic, Infomancy (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Renaissance_magic). There are also texts about how to perform "Infomancy", that is to create infohazardous information by putting together two other non infohazardous peices of information- which then become infohazardous, producing some sort of reaction which transmutes the matter that encodes the information. Its also revealed that this organisation has been recruiting by creating Cognitohazards in media that can only be read as recruitment by individuals who meet some prerequisites.

The purpose of their order is to catalog all reproducible infohazards.

This culminates into learning of their Library, a phisical location on earth that houses all reproducible infohazards, and if they are too dangerous they apply some method of logically distancing to neutralise its anomalous properties. If it is impossible to safley apply logical distancing, they apply other infohazards to contain them.

*Hook/Attention-Grabber:**
The mystery of what this secret organisation that pulled a reverso uno card on the foundation is, and what their extent and goals are. Also, interesting applications of infohazards and an effective system of hard magic based around them.

Additional Notes:
Ive had this idea for a long time. Using cognitohazards as an effective hard magic system is something ive put a lot of thought into.

item.title: How Long Can We Wait? - Cognitohazard SCP
item.description: There are 3 parts to this skip.
item.content:encoded:
There are 3 parts to this skip. A cognitohazard, an anomalous creature, and a dangerous site

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch:

Essentially, there are 3 parts to this SCP:
- The first is a cognitohazardous message. Once you read it, it will stay in your mind, slowly growing in you consciousness, eventually replacing all other thoughts, shutting down your motor functions, and killing you, as you will forget how to breathe. This cognitohazard can also be spread, and creates a strong desire in the infected to visit the second part of this skip.
- The second is an anomalous creature. It is located in a pit, and anyone who approaches or enters the pit will be filled with an extremely strong hatred towards the creature, and a powerful desire to end its life. The foundation believes, however, that if this creature were to die, it would result in an end-of-the-world scenario.

+ show block
– hide block

- The final part is a site, believed by the foundation to be the origin of the apocalypse should the creature ever be killed. the site is marked by a ring of 5 statues, 1 resembling the creature in the pit, and the other resembling redacted creatures that the foundation has already encountered. Additionally, every month, a creature spawns at this location, which must immediately be terminated by foundation personnel.

Central Narrative:
There isn't exactly a narrative per se, but the reader will slowly uncover more information about the SCP, and how the different parts of it relate together. Essentially, the message will draw the victim to the creature in the pit, and once they get there they will be compelled to kill the creature, beginning the apokalypse.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
I feel like the cognitohazard is a fairly unique premise, and the chain of events that could so easily lead to the apokalypse.

Additional Notes:
Considering going more in-depth through addendums as to who the other 4 statues are. They would be deceased creatures that the foundation has already encountered, implying that all five must be killed in order to free some cosmic being, and the creature in the pit is the last remaining "lock" if you will.

item.title: YoDoDaVoodoo.exe (SCP idea)
item.description: Keter level SCp idea that I wanted your thoughts on.
item.content:encoded:
The basic idea of this one is that it's a executable file that when opened it will show a caricature of a Voodoo priestess with the text: "Who do you wish to control?" If a person types another person's name into the box with knowledge of who the individual is (regardless if they have ever met or not) the victim will cease all control of their body. From there, the program will show a live video from the victim's perspective, with a log of their thoughts off the side of the window. Orders are given through a text box at the bottom of the program window. Finally, on the upper right corner of the screen there is a button that reads "Release". This will close the program, and release the control over the victim, with knowledge of everything they did, but not knowing why or how. Orders must be specific, as orders such as "Go to the store" will be interpreted by the program as "Go to the store I frequent". (A bit troublesome if the victim lives in New York and you live in Washington). And if not ordered to, the victim will walk to the destination, as opposed to easier methods of transportation. Typos nonsensical orders, and impossible orders are met with a message flashing in the middle of the window reading: "The spirits are confused by this order." If an order is given that will kill the victim, a warning will appear asking: "This will kill your victim, are you sure you wish to order this?" If "No." is clicked, the order is ignored. If "Yes" is clicked, the order will be performed, killing the victim. This program can be opened in any OS, and can be downloaded from online sources or burned onto a CD. It is Keter class as it keeps showing up in various file sharing websites, pawn shops, secondhand games stores etc.

How does that sound so far? Still not quite done, but I figured I'd get it out there.

item.title: Auntie's Apron (Second Go)
item.description: A revamp of an SCP I tried to make a while back, but sort of dropped it. Now I'm back to try again.
item.content:encoded:
Using Item # 5272 because that's just the place I want this SCP to fill so hopefully that isn't a drawback.

+ show block
– hide block

Item #: SCP-5272
Object Class: Euclid
Special Containment Procedures: SCP-5272 is to be kept in a low-risk humanoid containment chamber at Site-743. The inside of the containment chamber is to resemble that of a house. It is to be furnished with decorations in the style that was popular in 1970's America. 5272's chamber is to be complete with a living room that connects to a kitchen. The living room is to be furnished with a couch, coffee table, and an RCA AM100L 9-inch console television set. The kitchen area is to have red trim, white checkerboard tiles along the floor and wall, a functional sink, a gas stove oven, and cabinets filled with cooking ware. All of this was granted to SCP-5272 due to its compliance in testing.

When not attached to a host body, SCP-5272 is to be hung on a coat rack within the kitchen area of the containment chamber. If SCP-5272 wishes to cook something in its containment cell, Site-743 Guards must be present to make sure no accidents occur that could harm SCP-5272's host or burn down Site-743. To prevent fires there are smoke alarms inside and outside of SCP-5272's containment as well as fire extinguishers.

If SCP-5272 were to attempt escape whilst in a host body, the host is to be terminated on sight and SCP-5272 is to be taken to a barren containment chamber. No event like this has occurred with SCP-5272 and as such has been granted all of the perks it possesses.

When experimenting with SCP-5272 no personnel above D-Class are permitted to wear SCP-5272 without permission of the Site Director. Researchers conducting experiments that involve the manifestation of SCP-5272-1 must stay a distance of 25 meters away from SCP-5272. Though no 5272-1 manifestation has harmed personnel in any way, it is a safety precaution that the Site Director has made a note of.

Description: SCP-5272 is a red apron made of an unknown material that has white stitching on the front that reads "Auntie". SCP-5272 possesses a number of anomalous properties. The primary property being, any person who wears SCP-5272 is possessed by the personality of SCP-5272. Though no physical changes occur to the host, their mannerisms and voice change to fit that of SCP-5272's personality. SCP-5272's personality is that of a "sassy southern aunt who likes to cook" as quoted by SCP-5272 itself. When SCP-5272 possesses a host body, the host will not have any recollection of the events that occurred while possessed. Possession only ends when SCP-5272 is taken off (usually at 5272's own volition), or the host body goes unconscious.

SCP-5272's second anomalous property is its ability to manifest instances of SCP-5272-1. SCP-5272-1 is a manifestation of a kitchen in the area empty around SCP-5272. Since every instance of 5272-1 is different depending on the area SCP-5272 is in it was classified as an anomalous presence as well. SCP-5272 has admitted that it has no control over the appearance of contents of SCP-5272-1. Though 5272-1 instance usually contains, a heat source for cooking, a container for perishable goods, a container for non-perishable goods, water, cooking utensils, and a serving tray of some sort. See Experiment Log: 5272-1 for more details.

SCP-5272's third anomalous property is the apron that makes up 5272. Testing has shown that SCP-5272 is near indestructible. Analysis of the threads that make up SCP-5272 has been inconclusive. 5272 seems resistant to any cutting, stabbing, fire, bullets, acid, high powered lasers, and tearing. Note: This effect only applies to SCP-5272 and not the host body. For more details see Experiment Log: 5272-A.

SCP-5272's last anomalous property is its self-cleaning ability. Any dirt, grease, or foreign objects that become attached to SCP-5272 will slowly disappear within 2 hours. Neither researchers nor SCP-5272 themselves know where the substances end up.

Addendum: Retrieval Log 5272

SCP-5272 was initially discovered in █████, United States Georgia when residents at a local apartment complex reported a loud crashing noise from a nearby apartment belonging to college student Tasha █████. When local authorities arrived on the scene, they discovered Tasha wearing SCP-5272. As such 5272's anomalous effects took place and Tasha became a host for 5272. Local Authorities of course were not aware of this fact so no contact with the Foundation was needed.

SCP-5272 showed signs of confusion and the arrival of local authorities (who were caucasian), caused SCP-5272 to become defensive saying "I ain't goin' to get beat by no white man!". This caused SCP-5272 to become aggressive whereas the authorities restrained SCP-5272 and took it to the local police station for questioning.

When the authorities identified SCP-5272 as Tasha █████, SCP-5272 was adamant that it was not Tasha, though it couldn't quite remember it's original name. When they asked 5272 what it's last memory was before the incident, SCP-5272 remarked that it had just watched President Nixon's speech that was being broadcasted on television. Seeing as this event took place in 1974 and it was now 20██. Local foundation personnel came to the scene and took SCP-5272 in for further questioning. The authorities involved in the incident were administered Class-C amnestics. See SCP-5272 Interview Log for more details.

SCP-5272 Interview Log

Interviewed: SCP-5272

Interviewer: Dr. Alberts

Foreword: This interview was conducted at Site 743 after SCP-5272 was initially taken in by the Foundation. The interview took place as soon as SCP-5272 was taken to an interview room at Site 743.

<Being Log>

Dr. Alberts: Continuing where the police left off. You said that the last thing you remember seeing was President Nixon's speech?

SCP-5272: Mhmm, that's right honey. I remember it a bit better now. I was in the kitchen watching the television from afar watching the speech.

Dr. Alberts: Do you remember what year it was?

SCP-5272: I believe it was 1974. It hasn't been that long has it?

Dr. Alberts: It's 20██.

At this point in time SCP-5272 puts its hand on its forehead in distress

SCP-5272: Oh my…oh my god…

Dr. Alberts: There's no need to worry. You're in good hands with the foundation. Is there anything that you did recognize where you first woke up in the apartment?

SCP-5272: I did recognize my apron.

SCP-5272 gestures to the red apron that the host body is wearing at the time

Dr. Alberts: Can you take your apron off?

SCP-5272: I mean, if it's not necessary I'd rather keep it on. Makes me feel safe y'know. Since it's all I got here.

Dr. Alberts: I would say it's necessary. For the purpose of this interview at least.

SCP-5272: Alright, if you say so…

As SCP-5272 unties the apron and takes it off the host goes limp. Dr. Alberts calls for a guard to check the host's pulse. Soon after the host wakes up. From this point on the interviewee will be referred to as Tasha.

Tasha: Huh, where am I?

Dr. Alberts: You are currently at the SCP Foundation. Who are you?

Tasha: I'm Tasha █████.

Dr. Alberts: Do you recognize this apron perchance?

Tasha: Oh yeah! That's the apron I bought from that new flea market.

Dr. Alberts: Can you tell me where this flea market was?

Tasha: I believe I found it at ███████████.

Dr. Alberts: Thank you. I believe that will be it.

After this the apron was taken to an experiment room where a D-Class personnel was instructed to wear the apron. Upon doing so, SCP-5272's primary anomalous effect was determined to be the possession of whoever wears the apron. After the discovery, Tasha █████ was administered Class-B amnestics and sent home.

<End Log>

(This is where I'll end it for now. In the draft, I will include experiment logs pertaining to SCP-5271-1 instances and logs about testing the durability of the apron.)

No full drafts on the forums.

item.title: Fear That Walks (greenlight wanted)
item.description: This SCP is basically a creature which lives off of peoples fear. Therefore without fear this creature ceases to exist entirely. Also this is my second SCP concept.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: the basic idea of this SCP is that it is a creature which survives off of peoples fear. It’s constantly seeking out humans to scare so it can live. With this, this SCP has many anomalous abilities connected to its overall power that vary from simply making lights flicker, to moving objects without physically touching them. This SCP gains power from people’s fear of it. The SCP must scare their victim(s) enough in order to enter a state of solidity in which it can interact with people and objects. During this period the SCP resembles that of the average human male except it’s skin is completely black and it lacks hair of any sort. This SCP while in this form will seek to kill it’s victim(s) until it is stopped. It seems to be heavily resistant to all forms of harm, however very vulnerable to light. This SCP is very sensitive to light and can be seen smoking in any strengths of light. If it is exposed to light for too long it will return to its gas state. it can also be stopped if it’s victim(s) stops fearing it. After it is stopped or has killed its victim(s) it will return to its gas state.

Central Narrative: after obtaining this SCP the foundation begins testing and conducts a controversial test within the foundation which results in the death of 13 people; 4 of which were scientists, and the rest were young D-Class. The tests purpose will have been to examine which people were most fearful and how to curb this fear in order to have more confident workers; however it should be noted that this test was not approved by the (what would it be approved by? The ethics committee?) The scientist who conducted this experiment put together meetings regarding fear control days before he was executed. SCP-XXXX still has not been re-contained and the foundation is working on a procedure. The amount of deaths in the facility per week has dropped significantly since the meetings have been organized.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think what makes this SCP interesting is that it’s power is restricted by how fearful people are of it. If people do not fear it, it essentially becomes nothing.

Additional Notes: If you have any questions about specifics I can answer them

item.title: The Phantom
item.description: A cat-like apparition that consumes souls.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Page Layout: Class, containment procedures, a professional description of the SCP and what it does, followed by three incident reports.

Elevator Pitch: Put simply, SCP-XXXX is a cat-like apparition which consumes souls. It once had intangibility (Which it lost during an incident), and it can shield itself from all wavelengths of light, rendering itself invisible for a short duration.

It’s a hunter, so it stalks any kind of prey which catches its interest, though it prefers humans. It will stalk its target, memorizing all of its routines, mannerisms, and daily patterns in extreme detail. When they are at a point of vulnerability (Provided SCP-XXXX hasn’t lost interest) it will consume their soul.

After a large amount of souls are consumed, it exhales them into the form of a polychromatic sphere, which it then carries to an unidentifiable and unspecified location.

+ show block
– hide block

That’s how it’s going to be written, but in actuality, SCP-XXXX is bringing the sphere to a GOI (Of my creation) so they can use it to prevent some kind of cataclysmic event from occurring. The Foundation is unaware of this, and all they know is that whenever they try to take the sphere away from the SCP, several events occur:

  1. SCP-XXXX becomes extremely agitated.
  2. People start disappearing from the Foundation (They’re actually being dragged away by a hand of the SCP which actually causes the cataclysmic event.)
  3. Emergence of multiple anomalous entities appearing all over the world.
  4. Cataclysmic event occurs.

Central Narrative: It’s a question of morals. The Foundation has to escort SCP outside after it creates the sphere (Which can even be a problem at times), but each time it’s outside it also does what it wants, and consumes even more souls. Even though the SCP’s job is presumably important, is it morally correct for the Foundation to just let it go around killing people?

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Since the SCP has lost its intangibility and is now at odds with the Foundation, this prompts it to use its superior intelligence to resist and counteract any new containment procedures that the Foundation tries to come up with.

Additional Notes: Last time I left out a lot of details, since I was trying to summarize way too much. Hopefully this is a good balance of things. Once again, any advice is highly appreciated, and thanks in advance.
